instagram_product_search_discovery.observation: The project owner reports finding BudgetFitzz on Instagram while actively searching and comparing multiple fashion products.
instagram_product_search_discovery.interpretation: This is a positive discovery signal: BudgetFitzz surfaced during a high-intent product-research journey, suggesting that searchable product and styling content can contribute to account discovery.
instagram_product_search_discovery.limitation: This is one self-reported journey. It does not establish Instagram search ranking, population-level discoverability, reach, or conversion performance.
instagram_product_search_discovery.recommended_action: Retain clear product-category and styling language in captions and on-screen copy, then validate the signal with Instagram discovery-source insights, profile visits, follows, product or link actions, and a short 'How did you find us?' response field.
